step1_analysis.description: A linearizing active bias circuit for an RF power amplifier. It uses a diode-connected transistor stack to generate a reference voltage and a source/emitter follower to provide a low-impedance bias voltage to the RF transistor, preventing bias collapse under large signal drive.

paper_reference.title: A Silicon Bipolar Transmitter Front-End for 802.11a and HIPERLAN2 Wireless LANs

dc_power.description: DC power consumption of the bias circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current = IB + I_MQA. IB = 100uA. I_MQA mirrors IB approximately, so I_MQA ≈ 95uA. Total current = 195uA. Power = 1.8V * 195uA = 351uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on a 100uA reference current and the mirrored current in the source follower branch at 1.8V supply.

v_bias.description: DC bias voltage provided to the RF PA transistor

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the threshold voltage and overdrive of the diode-connected output transistor (MQ1) acting as the bias reference.

zout_dc_db.description: Low-frequency output impedance at the bias node (in dB ohms)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the transconductance of the source follower and diode-connected transistor, plus the series resistance RA.

zout_5g_db.description: High-frequency output impedance at 5.2 GHz (in dB ohms)

sky130_expected.calculation: At 5.2 GHz, CB (1pF) bypasses N0 to ground. Zout is similar to DC, dominated by 1/gm1 || (RA + 1/gmA).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The bypass capacitor ensures the gate of the source follower is at AC ground, maintaining low output impedance at RF frequencies to supply dynamic current.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, bias voltage, output impedance (AC), and load step response (Transient) of the active bias circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Active Bias Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT (Adapted from generic NPN to SKY130 NMOS)
IB VDD N0 100u
MQ1 RFin RFin GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5u l=0.15u
RB N0 N3 1k
RA N2 RFin 500
MQB N0 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5u l=0.15u
MQC N1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5u l=0.15u
CB N0 GND 1p
MQA VDD N3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10u l=0.15u

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
I_ac RFin 0 AC 1
I_step RFin 0 PULSE(0 1m 1n 100p 100p 5n 10n)

.control
* DC Sweep for Power and Bias Voltage
dc VVDD 0 1.8 0.05
let power = -i(VVDD) * v(VDD)
meas dc pwr_at_1v8 find power at=1.8
meas dc vbias_at_1v8 find v(RFin) at=1.8

* AC Analysis for Output Impedance
ac dec 20 1M 10G
let zout_db = vdb(RFin)
meas ac zout_dc_db find zout_db at=1M
meas ac zout_5g_db find zout_db at=5.2G

* Transient Analysis for Load Step Response
tran 10p 10n
meas tran v_max max v(RFin)
meas tran v_min min v(RFin)

quit
.endc
.end
